name: bugsmash
description: Review digital content and manage visual feedback with BugSmash.

interface.longDescription: BugSmash helps teams review websites, dashboards, mobile apps, videos, PDFs, images, and audio. Create review projects, collect comments at exact locations, discuss feedback, and track versions and approvals. Connect your BugSmash account to manage projects and feedback in ChatGPT. Access follows your BugSmash workspace permissions.
defaultPrompt: Summarize active feedback in my BugSmash projects.
Create a BugSmash review project for this website.
List my BugSmash projects and their latest versions.

positive.description: Find the demo image review project.
positive.prompt: Find the image review project named banner1.jpg in my default BugSmash Demo workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the BugSmash Demo workspace with list_workspaces and use its workspaceId where supported. Returns the banner1.jpg image review project from the demo workspace with its project details.

positive.description: Create a website review in the demo workspace.
positive.prompt: Create a website review project named MCP Reviewer Website Test for https://bugsmash.io/ in my default BugSmash Demo workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the BugSmash Demo workspace with list_workspaces and use its workspaceId where supported. Creates the website review project in the demo workspace and returns its project details and review link.

positive.description: Read feedback on the demo image project.
positive.prompt: Show the active comments on the banner1.jpg image project in my default BugSmash Demo workspace. Include comment numbers, plain text, and review locations.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the BugSmash Demo workspace with list_workspaces and use its workspaceId where supported. Finds the banner1.jpg project and returns its active comments with readable text and review locations. Follows pagination if more comments are available.

positive.description: List folders in the demo workspace.
positive.prompt: List the folders in my default BugSmash Demo workspace. Show Test folder 1 and its project count.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the BugSmash Demo workspace with list_workspaces and use its workspaceId where supported. Returns folders in the demo workspace, including Test folder 1 and its current project count.

positive.description: List versions of the demo image project.
positive.prompt: List the versions of the banner1.jpg image project in my default BugSmash Demo workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the BugSmash Demo workspace with list_workspaces and use its workspaceId where supported. Finds the banner1.jpg project and lists its versions, including the current V1 version shown in the demo workspace.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general image editing. The plugin should not be invoked because BugSmash manages review workflows and does not edit image content.
negative.prompt: Remove the background from this photo and make it transparent.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated project management. The plugin should not be invoked because the request does not concern a BugSmash visual review.
negative.prompt: Create a software engineering task in my sprint backlog.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general bug-priority education. The plugin should not be invoked because the user requested a general explanation without asking to read or change BugSmash data.
negative.prompt: Explain what P1 priority means in software testing.

publication.release_notes: Initial BugSmash plugin package with MCP tools and the manage-reviews skill.
